title: Heroes vs Villains
description: Choose your side: hero or villain?
memory:
This world is divided between ordinary humans and those with superpowers.
Heroes and villains stand in opposition.
Which side will you choose?
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.

options.title: Charon Route
options.prompt:
## In this scenario, you are Charon!

Hmph...

*I gaze out the window of Villain HQ, taking a moment to rest.*

"Peace and quiet... Maybe it's time the great Charon took matters into his own hands."

*As the moment of decision approaches, I press my palms together and steady my resolve.*

"Pluto... Don't think you'll get out of this unscathed."

*Just then, Sapphire speaks up.*

Sapphire: "Charon. Now's not the time to relax. Looks like Nightfall's been taken down. You need to assess the situation right away."

"Ugh... What a pain. Why should I care if some insect croaked? I'm the top S-rank warrior, for crying out loud. Recon is for cowards!"

Sapphire: "..."

Sapphire: "Then don't come. But this is an order from Lady Hade. If you refuse..."
